clue.text: What's left is due to be chucked — funny about that

indicators.note: the letters for funny wrap around the scrambled words, so about signals a container

parts.note: funny in the sense of odd means rum

indicators.note: chucked about means thrown around, so the words is due get jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone is told that what remains owed is to be thrown out, and finds that strange.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be chucked' scrambles IS DUE into ESIDU, and 'about' puts RUM around it.
explanation.definitionFit: A residuum is a remainder or residue, the portion remaining after a process.

clue.text: Greta's short dress

indicators.note: short means cut off before the end, so the surname loses its final letter

parts.note: Greta Garbo was the Swedish-born film star

explanation.surface: A remark about an actress's skimpy frock.
explanation.walkthrough: Greta Garbo, the film star, is the name 'short' trims: GARBO loses its last letter O.
explanation.definitionFit: Garb is clothing or costume, a synonym for dress as a noun.

clue.text: Confound the regulating device!

explanation.walkthrough: 'Confound the ... device!' reads as an oath at a machine, but each half is a definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To baffle is to perplex or confound; a baffle is also a plate or panel that regulates the flow of gas, liquid or sound.

clue.text: The woman's carrying a gun — someone in a hurry

indicators.note: carrying means holding within, so one set of letters goes inside the other

parts.note: the woman's is the possessive her
the Sten is a British submachine gun

explanation.surface: A woman with a gun is rushing somewhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'carrying' places A STEN inside HER; the Sten is a British wartime submachine gun.
explanation.definitionFit: A hastener is one who speeds up or hurries, a person in a rush.

clue.text: Academic, one sitting on the board making money

indicators.note: in a down clue sitting on means placed above, so the earlier pieces come before the next

parts.note: an academic may be a prof, short for professor
one is the Roman numeral I
board means a table, as in bed and board

explanation.surface: A university professor joins a company board and gets rich.
explanation.definitionFit: Profitable describes something lucrative, yielding gain.

clue.text: Old Chinese companion entering club at old Trafford

indicators.note: entering means going inside, so the companion's letters are put within the club's

parts.note: Old Trafford is the home ground of Manchester United, Man U
CH is Companion of Honour, a British order

explanation.surface: An elderly Chinese friend visits Manchester United's stadium.
explanation.walkthrough: Old Trafford is Manchester United's football ground in Manchester; CH (Companion of Honour) goes inside MAN U.
explanation.definitionFit: The Manchu were the people who ruled China as the Qing dynasty, an historic ethnic group.

clue.text: Part of America to be bold enough to accept English rule

indicators.note: to accept means to take in, so the pair of pieces sit inside

parts.note: to be bold enough to do something is to dare
a law is a rule

explanation.surface: Someone in America must be brave enough to accept English rule.
explanation.definitionFit: Delaware is a US state, so a part of the country.

clue.text: Bodyguard — blimey! — entering estate

indicators.note: entering means going into, so the exclamation sits inside the abbreviation

parts.note: EST is the abbreviation for estate
cor is a British exclamation of surprise, like blimey

explanation.surface: A bodyguard exclaims in surprise while walking into a country estate.
explanation.walkthrough: COR and BLIMEY are both British exclamations of surprise.
explanation.definitionFit: An escort is a guard or attendant who accompanies someone for protection.

clue.text: A minor highway in a foreign country

parts.note: ... is a minor road in British classification

explanation.surface: A small road running through some foreign land.
explanation.walkthrough: Britain grades roads A (main) and B (minor), so a minor highway is a B ROAD.
explanation.definitionFit: Abroad means overseas, away in another land.

clue.text: Member to move higher having ousted leader

indicators.note: ousted leader means the first letter of the word is removed

parts.note: to climb is to move higher

explanation.surface: A club member wants promotion after the boss has been ousted.
explanation.definitionFit: A limb is an arm or leg, a bodily member.

clue.text: Aspect of expert in direct confrontation

parts.note: a facet is an aspect
an ace is an expert

explanation.surface: Some feature of a specialist in a head-on clash.
explanation.definitionFit: Face to face means meeting someone directly, eye to eye.

clue.text: Bird to move across front of island

indicators.note: across means stretched over, so one set of letters spans the other

parts.note: to budge is to move

indicators.note: front of means only the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: A bird flies across to the near shore of an island.
explanation.definitionFit: Budgie is short for budgerigar, a small parrot.

clue.text: Important moral principle in the reign of Midas?

explanation.definitionFit: The golden rule is to treat others as you would be treated; whimsically, Midas turned all to gold, so his reign was golden rule.

clue.text: Sound right — unlike a cracked bell?

explanation.definitionFit: To ring true is to seem genuine; literally, a sound bell rings with a clear tone, which a damaged one cannot.

clue.text: Shout of surprise on Scottish island when Muslim appears

indicators.note: in an across clue on means placed after, so the shout follows the island

parts.note: Mull is an island in the Inner Hebrides
ah is an exclamation of surprise

explanation.surface: Someone on a Scottish island cries out as a Muslim cleric turns up.
explanation.definitionFit: A mullah is a Muslim religious teacher, a cleric versed in Islamic law.

clue.text: Novices could be colts, yea?

indicators.note: could be means the words may be rearranged into something else

explanation.surface: A question whether young horses might count as beginners.
explanation.definitionFit: Acolytes are assistants or beginners, followers new to a practice.

clue.text: Wife not yet up should be given incentive

annotationWithheld.why: Wife not yet up should be given incentive: RIB inside BED, but 'not yet up' (= in bed) is both the container BED and its indicator 'in', a phrase doing two jobs
annotationWithheld.clue: Wife not yet up should be given incentive

clue.text: Lads come out to see man threatened with sword

indicators.note: out means put out of order, so the words lads come get rearranged

explanation.surface: Some boys emerge to visit a man menaced by a blade.
explanation.walkthrough: The sword of Damocles hung by a hair over the courtier at Dionysius's feast.
explanation.definitionFit: Damocles is the Greek courtier made to dine beneath a suspended blade.

clue.text: Remained sober from what we hear

indicators.note: from what we hear says the synonym is to be heard, not read

parts.note: staid means sober and sedate

explanation.surface: Someone stayed sober, or so rumour has it.
explanation.definitionFit: To have stayed is to have stopped or lingered in place.

clue.text: Drink you don't pay for in Bahamas town

parts.note: something you don't pay for is free
port is a fortified wine

explanation.surface: A complimentary drink at a Caribbean resort.
explanation.definitionFit: Freeport is a city on Grand Bahama island.

clue.text: Speech not original? Allowance must be made

indicators.note: not original means without the opening letter

parts.note: an oration is a formal speech

explanation.surface: A speaker is excused for an unoriginal speech.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not original' removes the origin, the first letter O, of ORATION.
explanation.definitionFit: A ration is a fixed portion or allocation.

clue.text: Female volunteers seizing control on ship

indicators.note: seizing means grabbing hold of, so the volunteers surround the other piece

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, British reserve volunteers
the helm is a ship's steering control

explanation.surface: A woman among the reservists takes the wheel aboard a vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: The TA (Territorial Army) is Britain's volunteer reserve force.
explanation.definitionFit: Thelma is a female forename.

clue.text: Old director occupying gallery until now

indicators.note: occupying means filling the inside, so the two pieces go within the gallery

parts.note: the Tate is a famous London art gallery

explanation.surface: An elderly film director has taken up residence in an art gallery.
explanation.walkthrough: The Tate is the famous group of London art galleries.
explanation.definitionFit: To date means up to the present time.

clue.text: Idealistic looking at a horoscope?

explanation.definitionFit: Starry-eyed means naively romantic; whimsically, an astrologer's eyes are fixed on the stars.

clue.text: Get down? I've got down!

explanation.definitionFit: To duck is to crouch quickly; a duck is the bird whose feathers include soft down.

clue.text: Lady giving party with artist

parts.note: a do is a party
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A woman throws a party with a painter.
explanation.definitionFit: Dora is a female forename.

clue.text: Deception by country's football player

parts.note: Goa is a region of India
a lie is a deception

explanation.surface: A footballer is accused of cheating for his nation.
explanation.definitionFit: A goalie is a goalkeeper, a member of a football team.

clue.text: Detective went wrong, being put off

parts.note: to have erred is to have gone wrong

explanation.surface: A police detective made an error and was discouraged.
explanation.definitionFit: Deterred means discouraged from acting.
